# Calibration fixtures

`processing_calib.svg` is an unmodified calibration export from the Processing version:
`PaperPolyhedra/output/hourglasss_calib_9_18_13_30_50.svg` in the local PaperPrototyping
checkout (PaperPolyhedra, main branch, September 2026). The calibration file does not depend
on the shape, so any PaperPolyhedra export's `_calib_` file is equivalent.
